payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition and explanation of a second order co-occurrence matrix, detailing its construction and application in measuring semantic relatedness.

claims.text: A second order co-occurrence matrix is constructed from a first-order co-occurrence matrix and is used to create second-order co-occurrence vectors that represent the meaning of terms.
Second order co-occurrence vectors incorporate contextual information and semantic similarity scores to measure relatedness between concepts.
The integration of semantic similarity into second order co-occurrence vectors improves correlation with human judgments of similarity and relatedness.
